_comment: Mode catalogue. jaPRO modes come from the bundled Docker configs (see sources.json); this file only labels them
and records what they depend on. Base modes are templates taken from a real base server's mode configs, with
`disable_item_medpak` left out because no item has that classname.
`baseline_resets` gives base's own default for cvars base modes change where jaPRO's default differs; the reference records jaPRO's (g_forceRegenTime is 200 in the MP SDK's g_main.c).

modes.summary: Team FFA with sabers only, no pickups and single-player-style saber damage. Force limited to jumping and saber skills.
Team FFA with sabers only and no pickups. Team heal and team energize are disabled.
CTF with sabers, thermal detonators and trip mines, JK2-style saber combat and no pickups. Force limited to saber skills; capture limit 5.
Team FFA with sabers only, no pickups and single-player-style saber damage. Force limited to jumping and saber skills.
predator with multiplayer saber damage doubled, backslashes at a hundred times damage, the JK2 lunge and no friendly fire.
Sabers only: saber damage cut to a tenth, but backslashes at two hundred times damage. Race mode is off.
JK2 1.02-style saber combat and force, single saber only. Weapons stay on the map.
The JK2 saber damage system and rescaled stances: yellow at half damage, red at 0.7.
Single-player-style saber damage with jaPRO's saber and force tweaks turned off.

Every weapon except the concussion rifle, no health or armor pickups, double saber damage and force at rank 1, limited to jumping, protect and saber skills. Sets a capture limit of 7 for playing it as CTF.
Only the disruptor, at ten times weapon damage, and a faster run speed. Force limited to jumping and saber skills.
Only the rocket launcher and no splash damage, so only direct hits count. Force limited to jumping and saber skills.
Gun game (g_gunGame 2) with no pickups, no self damage and no falling damage. Force limited to jumping and saber skills.
Sniper rabbit: the flag carrier gets a disruptor, everyone else fights with sabers at ten times saber damage. No health or armor pickups; frag limit 50.
modes.maps_note: Needs a map with a neutral flag; the stock maps have none.

modes.summary: Rabbit where holding the flag scores points, with sabers at double damage, backslashes at a hundred times, the JK2 lunge and red DFA. Force limited to saber skills; 30-minute time limit and frag limit 200.
